highlights: Enjoy up to 12% cashback on supermarket spending (excluding Sheng Siong) with a minimum spend of S$600. Earn 1.60% cashback on all overseas purchases, with no cap and no minimum spend required. Plus, earn a baseline of 0.30% cashback on all other purchases. Total cash rebate for Sheng Siong is capped at S$75.
pros: Enjoy up to 12% cash rebate at Sheng Siong.
pros: Additional 6% cash rebate on your Sheng Siong purchases when you spend S$600 elsewhere.
pros: 1.6% unlimited cash rebate on your overseas spend including online purchases.
pros: 0.3% cashback on all other purchases.
cons: Minimum S$600 out-store spending required to get the 12% cashback at Sheng Siong. Otherwise, you will be awarded with 6% cash rebate which is not subject to any minimum spend.
cons: Total cash rebate for Sheng Siong is capped at S$75.

extra.description: Enjoy greater savings at Sheng Siong with the BOC Sheng Siong Card. Benefits include 6% cash rebate, and unlimited 1.5% cash rebate for overseas and local purchases.
